title: SWE-Ladder: Learning to Localize, Reproduce, and Patch via Progressive Privileged Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Resolving a repository-level issue typically requires a software-engineering (SWE) agent to localize the faulty code, reproduce the failure, and patch the code. Reinforcement learning trains such agents from a single test result on the final patch, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adds token-level supervision from a teacher with privileged evidence, exposing the full reference patch at every step. Neither provides stage-specific guidance for localization or reproduction. We propose SWE-Ladder, which turns the verified repair of each training instance into stage-specific evidence: the changed files and lines for localization, the fail-to-pass tests for reproduction, and the diff for patching. A rule-based router assigns each step of an end-to-end rollout to a stage based on its tool call, a frozen teacher sees only the matching evidence, and the stages are distilled in repair order while GRPO optimizes the full trajectory. With Qw

translated_title: SWE-Ladder：通过渐进式特权自蒸馏学习定位、复现与修补
translated_abstract: 解决仓库级问题通常需要软件工程（SWE）智能体定位故障代码、复现失败并进行代码修补。强化学习通过最终补丁的单一测试结果来训练此类智能体，而策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）则从拥有特权证据的教师模型中添加token级监督，在每一步都暴露完整的参考补丁。然而，两者都无法为定位或复现阶段提供针对性的指导。我们提出SWE-Ladder，将每个训练实例的已验证修复转化为特定阶段的证据：用于定位的变更文件和行号、用于复现的fail-to-pass测试，以及用于修补的代码差异。基于规则的路由器根据工具调用将端到端rollout的每一步分配到相应阶段，冻结的教师模型只接收与该阶段匹配的证据，各阶段按修复顺序依次进行蒸馏，同时由GRPO优化完整轨迹。使用Qw…（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SWE-Ladder框架，将已验证的修复过程分解为定位、复现和修补三个阶段的特权证据，通过基于规则的路由器和冻结教师模型按修复顺序进行渐进式自蒸馏，并结合GRPO优化完整轨迹，为SWE智能体提供了传统强化学习和OPSD所缺失的阶段特定训练指导。
en_tdlr: SWE-Ladder decomposes verified repairs into stage-specific privileged evidence for localization, reproduction, and patching, using a rule-based router and a frozen teacher for progressive self-distillation in repair order alongside GRPO trajectory optimization, providing stage-specific guidance that neither reinforcement learning nor OPSD offers for software-engineering agents.
